Subject: Launchwell pilot — pricing path, overage smoothing and one-time top-up

Hi Sasha,

Really enjoyed the demo yesterday — thanks for the thoughtful questions. Per our conversation, I wanted to propose a simple path to get Launchwell through a 90-day pilot with predictable economics and a clean conversion option: 

- 90-day pilot: 500k tokens included, no commitment beyond pilot.
- One-time promotional top-up: 200k tokens applied to pilot consumption (applied if you hit 80% of included tokens).
- Overage smoothing: If monthly consumption exceeds the included tokens, we'll invoice overages at a blended discounted rate for the pilot period (not the full list price).
- Conversion credit: If you convert to a dedicated or annual plan within 60 days post-pilot, we offer a one-time onboarding credit equal to any overage fees paid during the pilot (capped at $5k).

I've attached a short offer doc and a usage worksheet so you can plug in expected traffic. Importantly, this is a one-off promotional construct to reduce dropouts from bursty usage during demo/launch phases.

If this looks reasonable, can you confirm the pilot start date you prefer? Also tagging Lauren for approval on the promo top-up.

Best,
Ben

--

Sasha — great questions. Short answers and an example attached: 

1) Top-up trigger: yes — we can make the top-up evaluate cumulative pilot consumption (90-day window). That avoids monthly cliff effects.

2) Blended overage math (example):
- List overage: $0.012 per token (example list)
- Pilot blended rate: $0.0065 per token for overage during pilot (roughly 45% discount from list)
- Example: month with 300k tokens included + 150k burst => overage fee = 150k * $0.0065 = $975.

We can refine numbers once you share a typical token distribution — I left a sample row in the attached XLSX.

3) SOW signatory: I can execute the pilot SOW for the self-serve pilot construct (standard terms). For anything requiring an enterprise amendment (SLA, data residency), our legal will need to sign-off; add ~3 business days for an expedited signature.

If Sept 7 is the preferred start, we'll aim to have SOW and billing set up by Sept 3. Lauren — requesting on-the-record approval for the 200k one-time promo top-up and the blended overage rate for this customer.

Thanks,
Ben
